notes.title: Version 28.5: Get ready to jump into Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting News, Everyone![/h2]
This is our final patch before we make the big leap to Early Access tomorrow. We're thrilled about this milestone and hope you are too. Here’s what you can expect in this last update before the big day:

[h3]"Chain" missions[/h3]
Embark on thrilling multistage missions to earn more goldies and unlock new rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/bc576ec2f5b863f158c615e99f69e68764764de4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Voiceover for tutorial[/h3]
We've introduced a voiceover in the tutorial! It's not fully polished yet, but it’s there to enhance the experience for new players. Expect further improvements in upcoming patches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/6e9b25ad5434b016370556a57373749b948a69a2.png[/img]

[h3]New artwork[/h3]
Check out the fresh artwork for these cards: Ocean D. Finley, Archimimus, Alien Abduction, Firebrand Lassie, Clumsy Cactus, and Jurassic Canon Fodder. Thanks to our awesome artists for bringing these characters to life with their illustrations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/26949dee3328cba5dd8c506dcdb1cb720aea6369.png[/img]

[h3]New Movie Sets: [/h3]
Explore genre-themed movie sets now available in the store:
[list]
[*] Comedy: Dive into hilarious mix-ups at a fun fair.
[*] Mystery: Solve a bank robbery gone wrong with secret shadows lurking.
[*] Drama: Ramp up the telenovela tension in a wealthy family's estate.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3de5ddb07dba0cdd90c667cbb4b86bf0f3a11c7a.png[/img]

[h3]New Card Backs: [/h3]
We've added a variety of new card backs and other exciting goodies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/2faa59c9bdbaa5f0b6e7ce3aeb0104cf5d028128.png[/img]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added non-animated version of Sly, adjusted cost of animated Sly to be in line with other animated directors.
[*] CyboBoy and Bartender Hydra would not freeze from their planned attack, if they have been already frozen (thanks, @Dunkoro).
[*] After mass effects characters won't get stuck under each other and move to proper position on the set right away (thanks, @kramushka and friends).
[*] When you steal narrative points from opponent, your Sleight of hand trickster won't return back to your hand (thanks, @Majstor).
[*] If character under Bloodbeards effect attacks and dies during an attack, it won't steal the narrative points.
[*] Fixed Spikes visuals alignment.
[*] Character with lethal has to deal attack damage for it to activate, Spikes and Backfire is not considered attack damage (thanks, @Dunkoro)
[*] Making copy of the deck won't overwrite already exist copy.
[*] When collecting large number of bounty points after AoE, they are properly spread between Lead and the free narrative points (thanks, @NatriOn).
[/list]

[h3]Looking Ahead:[/h3]
This release sets the stage for our early access launch tomorrow. Get ready, spread the word, and dive into the world of ScreenPlay, where creativity meets cinema. Calling all visionary directors to join us!

notes.title: ScreenPlay Update 28.4
notes.notes:
Hey Directors! We've been hard at work adding new enhancements, content, and bug fixes. There's plenty more on the way as we gear up for our Early Access launch in May 2024. Help us spread the word and invite more players to join in on the fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3938a08893b163a81d4c56f9faaa7ab02cbf6420.png[/img]

[h2]Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new UI for cards in zones such as the opponent's hand and Extras, designed for easier navigation, viewing, and selection of cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3ba024414ba1f662f77d334f81605f21b6e44481.gif[/img]
[*] Enhanced card pack opening animations now include an exciting reveal of each card, along with the ability to preview a large visual of the card once the pack is opened.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/5ec92b9262524e4bf190f5a90e2422c2c064dbe5.gif[/img]
[*] Removed redundant FX type filters from the Collection.
[*] Introduced the "Queenpin max out" animation – watch Queenpin in action!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/d715ba47a5a12da5a95366c63ff67ce89a38a9aa.png[/img]
[*] Enhanced the flow of gameplay animations by tightening the logic between sequences and shortening select animations for a faster, smoother experience.
[*] Added functionality to scroll through the collection using the mouse wheel.
[*] New Card Backs and Movie Sets available in the Store.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]
[list]
 [*] Corrected an issue in the tutorial where players were prompted to dodge before being shown how.
[*] Added missing spikes VFX.
[*] Fixed a bug where Totem Boy's aura was reapplying every time a new character came on set. (Thanks, @yarractheeln)
[*] Ensured performance animations will not play if a character in the Extras or in the hand. (Thanks, @jetmanskye)
[*] Addressed an issue with extra characters performing due to Qaal; they will no longer perform if Qaal was removed from the set.
[*] The Undo button will not disappear correctly if you use Qaal's performance UI first. (Thanks, @toniemacaronie16 and @tougarashi3357)
[*] Resolved an issue where characters with the pack hunt keyword would perform an empty attack instead of dodging. (Thanks, @dunkoro)
[*] Fixed "Tag[*]in!" to disallow another character from the hand to play if the selected character is not present on set when "Tag[*]in!" is used.
[*] Fixed several issues with narrative sound, including potential duplication and volume control problems. (Thanks, @yarractheeln)
[*] Addressed text cut[*]off issues in the Collection search bar.
[*] Fixed misalignment issues in Illuminati Lizard and Roast Comic Frog max out animations. (Thanks, @n4trion)
[*] Corrected the "Performances Interrupted" mission to work correctly with different sources of interruption. (Thanks, @toaster404. )
[*] Resolved the Laugh Bot crash issue. (Thanks, @dunkoro)
[*] Fixed various other minor bugs and crashes.
[/list]

Additional Note: [i]The star of the 2001 movie Exit Wounds, Steven Seagal, a noted aficionado of carrot cake, had absolutely nothing to do with this update. Any rumors of his involvement are entirely unfounded and should be dismissed.[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 28.3
notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: Version 28.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Upgraded the game engine and gameplay logic, significantly fixing many old bugs and crashes. However, be aware of the possibility of new, missed bugs and crashes outside our scope of testing.
[*] Removed some debug features that were only meant for developers.
[*] Enhanced the tutorial for a better user experience.
[*] In the Collection, cards can now be added to the deck with a click, not just by dragging.
[*] Improved the visuals and stability of Alien Abduction (thanks to feedback from [b]Majstor[/b], [b]MageArmour[/b], [b]toaster404[/b]).
[*] Removed an unnecessary board transition at the end of matches.
[*] Added cards that were missing in bots' decks, shoutout to [b]toaster404[/b].
[*] Fixed several issues with missions.
[*] Made various visual improvements.
[*] Fixed Cybocock incorrectly doing a counterhit twice.
[/list]

[h2]Balance updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stripped OG now attacks the left flank instead of any random target.
[*] Auto attacks, like Brawling Broccoli's, now always go from left to right.
[*] Bartender Hydra now attacks from the left to the right flank.
[*] Trope damage can now be dodged.
[*] Puffer's Switch can now counter everything.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 27.7 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the game's full-screen mode to be borderless.
[*] Fixed a bug where Jaw-Z broke the rules of narrative collecting, reported by member of our community server [b]toaster404[/b].
[*] Fixed the problem of interaction between character abilities and stolen narrative, reported by member of our community server [b]Xekon#8266[/b].
[*] Fixed few crashed related to the user interface.
[*] Corrected the description of Pro-Profit Centurion and his legionnaires, thanks to our community server member [b]yarractheeln[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/faa64f2af278329259e6122737cfe61c3f2f4316.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Addressing a Notorious Crash[/h1]
The persistent [i]"Unable to get variable res from object XXXX"[/i] error has been a major point of discussion. Our gratitude goes out to [b]toaster404 [/b]and [b]Kram[/b] for their detailed reports. 

This issue was traced back to the game engine. We have [url=https://github.com/YoYoGames/GameMaker-Bugs/issues/3929]reported this to the engine developers[/url] and they've acknowledged it as a bug.

Currently, we've implemented a temporary fix. A complete resolution will follow with an upcoming engine update. A big thank you to our community for helping us identify these issues and for your continued patience.

notes.title: Happy New Year! Update 27.6 Released
notes.notes:
Season's Greetings, movie directors! Our latest update brings you a sleigh-load of improvements.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[b]Say goodbye to the freezing issue in the tutorial, and thanks for flagging it![/b]

Plus, we've ironed out several gameplay bugs, particularly those tricky corner cases.

[h1]Cards rebalancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Roast Comic Frog lead now gains 2 Narrative Points at the start of a scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3ec317ab2dda9d652e323195df37524c7156ad6c.jpg[/img]

[*] Jaw-Z lead now gains 2 Narrative Points for a successful performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/c716b6797f4615584f4adb35649787ac1f8d68ee.jpg[/img]

[*] Pro-Profit Centurion character now enters on the 4th frame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/87176beec9893b3bc13bc5f57c8ae09a5abc920d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Matchmaking tuning[/h1]
To enhance your gaming experience, our matchmaking system initially tries to find you a fellow player for a few minutes. During this wait, you'll see a pop-up offering two choices: either jump into a game with a bot or keep waiting for a real player. You also have the option to team up with a friend. If a player match isn't found after a certain period, the system might pair you with a bot for that round, but will try for a real player in the next. To make the most of your experience, we encourage you to invite friends to join the game. Playing with friends not only makes the game more enjoyable but also helps build our community. Plus, check out our Discord for PvP hours to play when our player base is most active.

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
We've added some visual flair to the game. Enjoy the new flat turtle animation, plus fireworks for the victory screen!
[previewyoutube=3e7qSv02Nq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Deckbuilding[/h1]
We're gradually introducing more intricate rules:

This update adds deckbuilding guidelines:
[list]
[*] Minimum 40 cards in a deck. maximum of 60.
[*] Include 2 or 3 lead cards.
[*] Leads' genres dictate other card genres.
[*] Amount of copies is determined by each card's rarity (number of dots in bottom left corner).
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/d9caecb9544df475659ec07c11771e55faee220d.jpg[/img][/center]
[center][i]Up to three copies for Bartender Hydra, four for Ben Bones' Edits.[/i][/center]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/092ddc489eaddac8e293a46a83b2a612e5a7cb6f.jpg[/img]
Heads up: Your deck might need some tweaking to comply with the new rules. We've updated our preconstructed decks accordingly. Happy building!
